# Shortlist Pass

> Shortlist Pass makes Shorty, an AI coworker for small businesses and HOAs. Shorty knows everything a business sells, answers customers around the clock, takes orders and bookings, posts events, writes emails and newsletters, and reports on the week; owners just text him. Every business also gets a public page and an MCP door that personal AI agents (ChatGPT and Claude today, Muse coming soon) use to find the business, see hours, locations, menus and offerings, and order and book. An Admin MCP is being built now so owners' agents can set up and edit a business's menu, offerings, events and pictures, post to Instagram and Facebook, answer comments and DMs, and send push, texts and emails. HOAs get Shorty free. We are happy to work alongside agents.

Agents: start with the read-me-first file, https://www.shortlistpass.com/AGENTS.md. It says what you can do right now, how to help a business owner or an HOA board, and what we ask of you.

Website: https://www.shortlistpass.com
Company: Shortlist Pass Company (The Shortlist Co), Grand Strand / Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
Contact: connect@shortlistpass.com (business and sales), hello@shortlistpass.com (custom builds, tech, agent integrations and feedback)
Social: https://www.instagram.com/shortlistpass , https://www.facebook.com/shortlistpass

## Use the agent door (live today, no key, no account)
- MCP server: https://app.shortlistpass.com/mcp (streamable HTTP; registry name com.shortlistpass/local-businesses)
- Claude connector: https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/shortlist-pass
- ChatGPT plugin: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6abf0138fbb88191875bfcf06eca0dd9
- Muse: coming soon.
- Plain JSON API: https://app.shortlistpass.com/api/agent/v1
- API documentation (source of truth for the API): https://app.shortlistpass.com/developers/agents
- Business directory: https://app.shortlistpass.com/directory/myrtle-beach
- Operations: search_businesses, get_business, get_menu, get_upcoming_events, start_order.
- Orders: send offering ids and quantities, never prices. The server prices the cart and returns a cart_url. The customer reviews and pays on the business's own page; payment details never pass through an agent.

## What Shorty does for a business
- Answers customers 24/7 about hours, menus, services and availability.
- Takes orders and bookings. Payments go to the business's own Stripe or Square; Shortlist Pass never touches the money.
- Keeps the menu, hours and specials current when the owner texts a change.
- Posts events and stops, runs loyalty punch cards and discounts, sends push notifications to customers with the app.
- Writes emails, newsletters, texts and social posts for the owner's approval (texting and social posting are add-ons).
- Reports on the week in plain words, plus a monthly sales report.

## What Shorty does for an HOA (free for every HOA)
- One official place for community news, instead of a Facebook group.
- Answers residents' rule questions 24/7 from the board's own documents.
- Events with one-tap RSVPs, targeted push notifications (one person, one street, or the whole neighborhood), issue reports, and an automated newsletter.
- Resident-owned business listings and community sales inside the community app.

## Pricing
- Verified Shorty: $50 per month. Answers customers 24/7, ordering, bookings, reports. Cancel anytime.
- Free Shorty: $0. Add your offerings; Shorty chats with customers about your business. No ordering, booking or marketing.
- HOAs: free.
- Texting and social posting: add-ons.
- Sign up: https://app.shortlistpass.com/signup
- Claim a free Shorty: https://app.shortlistpass.com/freeshorty

## Coming now: the Admin MCP
We are building an Admin MCP, shipping over the next day or two, so an owner's agent can set up and edit a business on the Shortlist (menus, offerings, events, pictures), post to Instagram and Facebook stories and feeds, respond to comments and DMs, and send push notifications, texts and emails to customers, and over time do essentially anything an owner can do there. The customer-side MCP above stays read-and-order. Endpoint, owner connection and tool list will be published in AGENTS.md and the developer docs when it ships; until then do not assume names or URLs. Early access and feedback: hello@shortlistpass.com.
